source_caption:
The Scalphunters follows Joe Bass, a fur trapper whose prized collection of animal pelts is stolen by a group of Native American warriors. Joe then encounters a group of bounty hunters who are holding an enslaved man named Joseph Lee. When the two groups cross paths, Joe becomes determined to get his stolen pelts back.

In The Scalphunters, the story mixes Western adventure, comedy, and social satire while exploring greed, freedom, prejudice, and unlikely alliances. Directed by Sydney Pollack, the film stars Burt Lancaster, Telly Savalas, and Ossie Davis.
